Written to `library/domains/engineering/domains/tech/domains/computing/texts/cline-architecture-analysis.md`.

The analysis covers all six focus areas from the Cline source code:

- **Plan Mode**: Hard modal split with tool-availability gating, `needs_more_exploration` mid-response signal, deep planning with model-family-aware variants
- **Context management**: Three-tier system — proactive token truncation, agent-driven summarization with structured 9-section template + auto-file-loading, and session chaining via `new_task`
- **.clinerules**: Conditional rules with YAML frontmatter, three scopes (global/local/remote), fail-open parsing, explicit "what NOT to add" guidance
- **MCP integration**: Centralized McpHub with lazy doc loading, full schema injection, per-tool auto-approval
- **Subagents**: Up to 5 parallel read-only research agents with configurable models and tool sets
- **VS Code patterns**: Checkpoint-per-tool-execution, protobuf communication, layered state persistence

Seven concrete adoption recommendations at the end, ranked by leverage for our harness.
